description: Hand-written model responses for the offline `pnpm demo` walkthrough (LLM_PROVIDER=fake) of the discount-cap pull request. They were not produced by a model: they stand in for one so the real indexer, retrieval, verifier, publishing, and dashboard can be seen without an API key. Run `pnpm demo --record` with a configured model to capture real responses instead.

findings.title: buildInvoice still passes (subtotal, percentOff) to applyDiscount after its parameters were swapped
findings.description: applyDiscount now takes the percentage first and the amount second, but its caller buildInvoice in src/billing/invoices.ts (not part of this diff) still calls applyDiscount(subtotal, coupon.percentOff). The subtotal in cents is treated as the percentage (and capped at 30) while the coupon percentage is treated as the amount, so every discounted invoice is computed from the coupon's percent value instead of the order subtotal.
findings.impact: Any invoice issued with a coupon is billed at a few cents instead of its discounted subtotal; revenue is lost silently because both arguments are numbers and the code still compiles.
